overview.summary: Experience Chennai’s vibrant culture, historic forts, and seaside charm in a balanced 3‑day solo weekend getaway.
overview.best_time_note: Late September offers pleasant temperatures, low humidity and the city’s cultural festivals are winding down, making attractions less crowded.

weather.conditions: Warm, partly sunny with occasional showers

options.details: Mumbai LTT to Chennai Central (Superfast Express). Departs 18:00, arrives 22:30 next day. Includes AC 3‑Tier sleeper.
Direct flight Mumbai–Chennai, 1h 45m. Multiple airlines; early morning departure.

transport.recommendation_reason: Fits the balanced pace, saves budget for experiences, and offers a chance to rest on the journey.
transport.local_transport: Auto‑rickshaws, Uber/Ola cabs, and prepaid city taxis

stay.area_recommendation: T. Nagar – central, well‑connected, bustling markets, close to Marina Beach and major sights.

options.name: Hotel Chennai Residency
options.why_good: Clean rooms, 24 h front desk, walking distance to bus/metro, good solo‑traveller vibe.

options.name: The Raintree Hotel
options.why_good: Heritage property, rooftop pool, close to cultural sites.

itinerary.title: Departure from Mumbai & Arrival in Chennai

morning.tip: Arrive 30 min early for luggage check
Carry snacks, a water bottle and a light blanket

evening.activity: Arrive Chennai Central, take prepaid taxi to hotel
evening.tip: Keep small change for taxi meter
Ask for a quiet floor for better rest

meals.dinner: Masala dosa at Murugan Idli Shop (near hotel)

afternoon.activity: Lunch – Chettinad chicken at Buhari Hotel
Walk along Marina Beach, try sundal
afternoon.tip: Stay hydrated, watch for strong sun

evening.activity: Dinner – Seafood platter at The Wharf
evening.tip: Reserve a seat with sea view

morning.activity: Breakfast – Idli & sambar at Saravana Bhavan
Visit Government Museum & National Art Gallery

afternoon.activity: Lunch – Filter coffee & vada at a local stall
Check‑out and head to Chennai Central
afternoon.tip: Store luggage at hotel if train departs later

evening.activity: Board overnight train back to Mumbai

places_to_visit.name: Fort St. George
places_to_visit.why_visit: First British fortress, museum of colonial artifacts

places_to_visit.name: Marina Beach
places_to_visit.why_visit: Longest urban beach in India, sunset views

places_to_visit.name: Government Museum & National Art Gallery
places_to_visit.why_visit: Extensive South Indian art and archaeology collection

safety_and_tips: Carry a copy of ID and train ticket
Use reputable ride‑hailing apps after dark
Stay hydrated, Chennai can be hot
